exposure: Fetal growth restriction (EFW <10th centile and CPR <0.6765 MoM)
Fetuses with apparent normal growth (EFW ≥10th centile) and abnormal CPR (<0.6765 MoM)
Small for gestational age (EFW <10th centile and CPR ≥0.6765 MoM)
Normal fetuses (EFW ≥10th centile and CPR ≥0.6765 MoM)
cohort: 943 pregnancies that underwent ultrasound evaluation of EFW and CPR at or beyond 34 weeks
finding: The study found that fetuses with apparent normal growth but abnormal CPR had a higher risk of intrapartum fetal compromise and suggests that delivery at 39 weeks may be beneficial for this group.
